Hang Luoc Street is located in the Old Quarter of Hanoi within Hoan Kiem District. The street stretches for 264 meters, starting from Hang Cot Street and ending at the intersection of Hang Ma, Cha Ca, and Thuoc Bac streets.

Historically known as Song To Lich Street due to its proximity to the old To Lich River, it was renamed Hang Luoc because of the many shops that sold combs. Today, Hang Luoc Street is where city residents come to handle funeral and celebratory matters.
